Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the action verb “玩”. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，“装” cannot directly introduce an action in this meaning; “假装 + verb phrase” expresses pretending to do an action. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：孟子是一个小男孩，他小的时候，On a character’s first mention, introduce the character with a fuller noun phrase before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Since “孟子” was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes as the referent, use the pronoun “他”. [rule: reference_form]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character. [rule: reference_form]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 妈妈：他的妈妈，This is the mother’s first mention, so use a full noun phrase that clearly identifies whose mother she is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬了家，This is a completed move at age five, so use “了” to mark the completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点状语应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装”不能这样直接搭配动作，“假装祭拜”正确。
按教师标准，首次出现孟子时需要先作简短介绍。
孟子刚在前句出现，按教师的近距离回指规则应使用“他”。
这是对刚出现的孟子的近距离再次提及，应使用“他”。
母亲首次出现时，按教师标准应明确为“他的妈妈”。
五岁时搬家是已完成的事件，应说“搬了家”。
